title: Fourth moment bound for the noise operator
statement:
For every natural number $n$ and every function $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, let $T$ be the Walsh noise operator that multiplies the coefficient indexed by $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ by $(1/\sqrt{3})^{|S|}$. Then
\[
\mathbb E_x[(Tf(x))^4]\leq \bigl(\mathbb E_x[f(x)^2]\bigr)^2,
\]
where both expectations are uniform over the sign cube.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
